## CLIPYARD · Error workflow global
Setiap workflow stage (HOOK/NOVA/LEXA/PIXEL/BOLT) → **Settings → Error Workflow = workflow ini**. Saat eksekusi mana pun crash, job agen terkait otomatis `failed` → hoodie dapat ring merah + chip ERROR di diorama (insiden terlihat, bukan tersembunyi di log).

**Ganti:**
1. `http://127.0.0.1:8787` → URL Floor API.
2. `clipyard-dev-token` → token kamu.
3. Pemetaan workflow → agentId di node Code (tambahkan sesuai workflow kamu).

Payload error n8n berisi `workflow.name`, `execution.id`, `execution.error.message`.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jobId: $json.jobId, agentId: $json.agentId, status: 'failed', progress: 0, title: 'Workflow error — ' + $json.message }) }}
